title: Horizon glow claims, photo fly-through and podium
summary: A 60 s voice-led pitch on black with a blue horizon glow: phone peek, one-word claims, a fly-through wall of frustrated photo tiles, then one feature per beat (button press, card grid, podium count, tilted phone) and a typed URL lockup.
use_when: A 60 s voice-over explainer for a marketplace, wallet or payments app
The story needs a clear pain beat before the product appears
Several features, each one short line plus one visual, no footage
Dark brand with one cool accent colour that can carry a horizon glow

look.type_style: bold grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, white; claim words ~7 % H, feature lines ~5 % H in 1–2 lines, left or right aligned next to the phone

sfx.event: wordmark line and URL type on
card grid and cross icon pop in
camera flies through the photo wall
phone slides in beside a feature line

structure.shot: two-line quoted title over pure black, phone top barely visible at the bottom; 2 fr lead-in
structure.motion: none (2 fr); the horizon glow switches on at the cut

structure.shot: same title on black with blue horizon glow; phone top with a marketplace page rises under it, two token coins float at the sides
structure.motion: phone rises from bottom edge 0.27→0.50, springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); coins drift in from edges 0.27→0.50 and bob ±2 %; phone sinks out 4.27→4.77 easings.inExpo ~15 fr (±0.25 s); title fades by 5.00

structure.shot: empty horizon glow, then three claims one at a time centred: one word, one word, two-word line in two rows
structure.motion: each claim blur-in rising ~0.3 H from below, easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s): at 5.77, 6.50, 8.00; previous claim cut away on the same frame; last claim gone by 10.27

structure.shot: inset dark panel with a glowing blue rim; ~20 photo tiles of frustrated people scattered in depth
structure.camera: fly forward through the tiles, zoom 9–17 %/s (motion.json), drifting up then left
structure.motion: tiles grow and slide off the frame edges as the camera passes them, easings.linear; new tiles come up from depth; rounded corners ~12 % of tile

structure.shot: same photo wall, camera bends right; a different tile reaches the foreground every ~0.75 s
structure.camera: fly forward 12–15 %/s with pan right 9–17 px/s @1920
structure.motion: easings.linear travel; foreground tiles exit past the frame edge within ~0.5 s each (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: wall settles back to its opening layout, one tile in front

structure.motion: lockup fades in 20.00→20.27 (±0.25 s); line types 20.27→21.00 at ~10 chars/s; whole group lifts slightly 21.27→21.50 and is gone at 21.77

structure.shot: frosted pill button with one-word label slides from right to centre; hand cursor arrives and presses it
structure.camera: static, then whips up-left at 24.00 (motion.json 71/89 px/s)
structure.motion: button slide 22.50→23.00 springs.ui ~12 fr (±0.25 s); cursor enters 23.27, springs.click press ~23.75 (not measurable); button and cursor carried up-left 24.00

structure.motion: grid settles 24.50→24.77 springs.layout (overshoot not measurable); heading fades in 25.00→25.27; top row slides down out of frame 25.77→26.00

structure.motion: word blur-in left to right 26.27→26.50 easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s); card row exits down 26.77→27.00; word gone at 27.27

structure.motion: cross pops 27.50 springs.pop (overshoot not measurable); line word-reveal 27.50→27.77; cross grows ~1.6× 29.00→29.50 then shrinks 29.77→30.27; line exits 30.27

structure.motion: medals drop from above 38.00→38.27 springs.pop (overshoot not measurable); counters appear 38.77 and roll 0→final 39.00→39.77 easings.outQuint ~24 fr; label rises 40.27; all cut away at 41.00

structure.shot: three one-word verbs, one at a time, large and centred, after 0.75 s of empty glow
brand mark plus wordmark centred, URL types on underneath, holds to the end
structure.motion: lockup scales 1.6→1.0 58.00→58.27 springs.cameraOut (±0.25 s); URL types 58.00→60.00 ~6 chars/s; hold 0.65 s

params.brand: brand.json: bg black, accent drives the horizon glow, fg white for all copy, display font bold grotesk
params.content.title: two-line opening title over the phone peek
params.content.painPhotos: 12–20 photo tiles for the fly-through (stock, people frustrated with the old way)
params.content.intro: line typed under the lockup that names the product
params.content.button: one-word button label for the press beat
params.content.cards: 6 product card images for the grid
params.content.features: 6–8 feature lines, ≤ 8 words each, each with a visual (cross, hands, podium, phone)
params.content.url: URL typed under the end lockup
params.vo: VO file and its line timings; rows follow the VO lines

notes: Studied from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); no 30 fps strips. Only 3 real cuts (0.07, 10.50, 19.50); everything else is one shot with state changes. SFX are all planned by the glue rule, not measured: the reference has music and VO only as far as we can tell. Spring names, overshoot and stagger are suggestions. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): rim-panel (inset screen with glowing rim, rows 4–6), coin-flip (tokens flip in held hands, row 12), podium (three ranked medals with counters, row 14). Rows 3, 12, 15, 16, 17 merged from state changes to stay at 18 rows.
